properties.description: The `read` and `write` verbs' classification. read_may_run decides from the tool's served read_only_hint (as --call read it) plus item 1's file rule (service::writes_a_file), and words the refusal that names `reflow2 write <tool>`. listing is `read --list`. The module doc says why the verbs live in the binary and why one rule is enough. main.rs fills --call's own fields from the verb and calls read_may_run before anything is opened, so the verbs are not a second door.
properties.name: verbs.rs
